meta.title: Kaufman Ion Source
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHS-KFIS Kaufman ion source complete equipment supporting Ar/Xe and other propellants with adjustable extraction/acceleration voltages. Suitable for materials processing, thin film deposition, electric propulsion ground testing, and beam research. Optional neutralizer and cooling modules with flange customization, supporting equipment procurement and technical consulting.
page.title: Kaufman Ion Source
page.lead: Mature ion source supporting inert/process gases for research and process beams.
detail.title: Kaufman Ion Source XHS-KFIS
detail.overview: Designed for surface processing, deposition, and thruster test stands. Supports multiple gases, tunable extraction/acceleration voltages, optional neutralizer and cooling for long-duration runs and diagnostics.
detail.feature1: Supports Ar / Xe / N₂ and other gases
detail.feature2: Adjustable extraction/acceleration voltages for parameter scans
detail.feature3: Optional neutralizer and cooling for extended operation
detail.feature4: Custom beam/ports for easy vacuum and diagnostics integration
